title: RBI's Monetary Policy Committee reviews the repo rate 🎯
body: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) met for its scheduled bi-monthly review to assess the repo rate against inflation and growth targets. The repo rate is the rate at which RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks, and it is the primary tool used to manage liquidity and inflation in the economy.
remember: MPC has 6 members — 3 from RBI + 3 external experts
RBI Governor chairs the MPC
Inflation target band: 4% (+/- 2%)
statics: Repo Rate ≠ Reverse Repo Rate — reverse repo is the rate RBI pays banks
RBI was established in 1935; HQ in Mumbai
source: Sample entry — verify with RBI press release

title: National Youth Day observed across India 🎉
body: National Youth Day is observed every year to mark the birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda, celebrating his contribution to youth empowerment, education and spiritual thought.
remember: National Youth Day: 12 January
Marks birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda (born 1863)
statics: Swami Vivekananda's real name: Narendranath Datta
Famous for his 1893 Chicago speech at the World's Parliament of Religions

title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana expands rooftop solar coverage ☀️
body: The scheme aims to enable households to install rooftop solar panels and receive subsidised electricity, reducing dependence on grid power and lowering household energy bills, as part of India's renewable-energy push.
remember: Aims to provide free/subsidised electricity via rooftop solar
Targets crores of households under phased rollout
statics: Ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
Part of India's larger renewable energy capacity goals

title: ISRO continues progress on upcoming satellite missions 🛰️
body: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) reviewed progress on its upcoming missions, continuing its track record in satellite launches, interplanetary missions and indigenous launch vehicle development.
remember: ISRO HQ: Bengaluru
Aditya-L1: India's first solar observation mission
Chandrayaan-3 achieved a soft landing near the Moon's south pole in 2023
statics: ISRO founded in 1969 by Dr. Vikram Sarabhai
Satish Dhawan Space Centre is in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh

title: National Sports Awards recognise top athletes 🏆
body: The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award, India's highest sporting honour, along with the Arjuna Awards, were conferred on athletes for their outstanding contribution to their respective sports.
remember: Khel Ratna is India's highest sporting honour
Named after hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand since 2021
statics: Arjuna Award recognises consistent excellence over 4 years

title: India adds new wetlands to the Ramsar list 🐦
body: New wetland sites were recognised under the Ramsar Convention, an international treaty for the conservation of wetlands of international importance, boosting India's tally of protected wetland ecosystems.
remember: Ramsar Convention signed in Ramsar, Iran in 1971
India has one of the largest networks of Ramsar sites in Asia
statics: World Wetlands Day: 2 February
Wetlands regulate water cycles and support biodiversity

title: World Bank report highlights India's growth outlook 📈
body: A World Bank report assessed India's macroeconomic trajectory, noting resilience in domestic demand and structural reform progress while flagging global headwinds for emerging economies.
remember: World Bank HQ: Washington D.C.
Comprises IBRD + IDA + IFC + MIGA + ICSID
statics: World Bank President is elected for a 5-year term
India is a founding member of the World Bank

title: International Booker Prize shortlist announced 📚
body: The International Booker Prize, awarded for a single book translated into English and published in the UK or Ireland, announced its shortlist, drawing global attention to translated fiction.
remember: Prize money is split equally between author and translator
Awarded annually, distinct from the (English-original) Booker Prize
statics: Geetanjali Shree's 'Tomb of Sand' was the first Hindi novel to win it (2022)
Administered by the Booker Prize Foundation, UK

title: UPI transaction volumes hit fresh milestones 💳
body: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) continued to record strong month-on-month transaction growth, reinforcing India's position as a global leader in real-time digital payments.
remember: UPI developed by NPCI, launched in 2016
Enables instant bank-to-bank transfer via a Virtual Payment Address
statics: NPCI = National Payments Corporation of India
UPI Lite enables small-value offline-friendly transactions

title: India's rank in the Global Innovation Index reviewed 💡
body: The Global Innovation Index, published annually, ranks countries on innovation input and output indicators such as R&D investment, institutions, infrastructure and creative outputs.
remember: Published by WIPO (World Intellectual Property Organization)
India has shown a steady improving trend over the past decade
statics: WIPO is a UN specialised agency, HQ in Geneva
